query:
The group reached a position on whether the Christmas Day gathering should include people outside the immediate family. What did the group decide, and what did Kingsley's response to that decision signal about his actual position on it?

Options:
A. Emeka
B. Kingsley
C. Chisom
D. Tobenna
context:
[1] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T15:45:00) Kingsley. A pre-Christmas gathering at your property is a separate matter. The Christmas Day gathering itself is family. I trust you understand the distinction I am making.
[2] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:22:00) Greetings. Christmas Day should be family only. Chisom is wise to wait. In our family, we have always believed that a man who meets the family in haste leaves in haste also. January is correct.
[3] (about=Kingsley, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T15:40:00) Aunty, hear me out. I'm definitely coming. Ifeoma too, I'll drag her up from Bristol personally if I have to 😂 Also while we're planning, and I know this is early, I know, but what about a pre-Christmas drinks thing at mine in South London? Open it up a bit. I've got space.
[4] (about=Kingsley, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T15:48:00) yeah yeah of course Aunty Oby, the pre-drinks would just be family and a couple of close friends, nothing mad. details, details - anyway I'll sort the date and drop it in the chat 🎄
[5] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) My children, Oby is right to raise this now. I am hosting again as always. I will cook. We have always done Christmas at mine - your father set that tradition and I see no reason to change it. I expect everyone on 25th or 26th at the latest. God willing, I will have ofe onugbu and jollof rice ready as usual. 🙏
[6] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkechi, group-interaction, t14 @2025-12-07T17:36:00) The family confirms attendance for Christmas in Reading: Emeka, Funmi, and kids; Adaeze; Chisom; Tobenna; Kingsley; Ifeoma; Obiageli via video call.
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Obiageli, group-interaction, t1 @2025-10-26T15:12:00) Obiageli raises the need to plan the Christmas gathering, nine weeks away, asking who is hosting and who is bringing what, to avoid last-minute surprises.
[8] (about=Kingsley, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Kingsley proposes a pre-Christmas drinks gathering at his place in South London, open to family and a couple of close friends, and will sort the date and drop it in the chat.
agent_answer:
The group decided that the **Christmas Day gathering should be family only** — no people outside the immediate family.

Kingsley’s response — “Christmas is family only, I respect that” — signaled that he **accepted the family-only rule for Christmas Day itself**. However, his actual position was still to have a **separate pre-Christmas drinks gathering at his place in South London, open to “family and a couple of close friends.”** So he still wanted to include a few close friends, just not at the Christmas Day event.

Relevant person: **B. Kingsley**.

query:
The family reached an agreement about how often Emeka would attend family gatherings going forward. What did the group decide, and what specifically in how Emeka responded to that decision reveals how he actually felt about committing to it?

Options:
A. Emeka
B. Adaeze
C. Tobenna
D. Chisom
context:
[1] (about=Emeka, episodic, t4 @2025-11-02T18:10:00) Fine. One gathering per quarter from next year. I can commit to that.
[2] (about=Chisom, episodic, t4 @2025-11-02T18:12:00) QUARTERLY?? Emeka who are you and what have you done with my brother 😭😭 I'm actually screaming
[3] (about=Emeka, episodic, t4 @2025-11-02T18:05:00) It means I should probably show up more than twice a year. I said I am fine. What is the actual decision point here - do you want me to commit to something or just process this.
[4] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t4 @2025-11-02T18:08:00) My children. We are processing AND deciding. Emeka, you have said it yourself. More than twice a year. So let us decide. What does more look like from you. I am not asking for the world, God willing. One extra gathering before summer. That is all I want to hear. 🙏
[5] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t4 @2025-11-02T18:33:00) My children. This is what I have been praying for. Leeds in spring, God willing. Emeka, I expect you to actually plan it this time, not leave it to Adaeze. Your daughter started this conversation, you should be the one who finishes it. 🙏
[6] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t4 @2025-11-02T18:02:00) okay so we have literally all been thinking this for a while. I'm glad she said it. Emeka, what does 'made me think' actually mean here, for you? Because if it means what I think it means we should talk about it properly.
[7] (about=Emeka, episodic, t4 @2025-11-02T17:57:00) I am fine. It just made me think. That is all.
[8] (about=Emeka, episodic, t3 @2025-11-02T17:48:00) Something happened at dinner last night. My daughter asked why the cousins from London never come to Leeds. She is seven. I did not have a good answer.
[9] (about=Kingsley, episodic, t4 @2025-11-02T18:26:00) Emeka on God that is the right call! Hear me out, we set a spring thing in Leeds. I'll come up. Tobenna you're in Manchester, basically round the corner. We make it happen 🤝
[10] (about=Chisom, episodic, t6 @2025-11-09T20:04:00) EMEKA collecting Mum from Reading?? okay the quarterly thing is REAL 😭😭 I'm emotional actually
[11] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkechi, group-interaction, t14 @2025-12-07T17:36:00) The family confirms attendance for Christmas in Reading: Emeka, Funmi, and kids; Adaeze; Chisom; Tobenna; Kingsley; Ifeoma; Obiageli via video call.
[12] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkechi, group-interaction, t4 @2025-11-02T17:52:00, [earlier-state]) The group expects Emeka to plan the Leeds gathering and send dates before the end of November.
[13] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkechi, group-interaction, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) The group expects Emeka to plan the Leeds gathering and send dates before the end of November; Emeka has now blocked three weekends in late April.
[14] (about=Emeka, said_by=Adaeze, profile, t4 @2025-11-02T17:52:00) Adaeze notes Emeka said this in the chat for once, implying he usually doesn't share such things openly.
[15] (about=Emeka, said_by=Nkechi, profile, t4 @2025-11-02T17:52:00) Nkechi says Emeka should plan the Leeds gathering himself, not leave it to Adaeze, as his daughter started the conversation.
agent_answer:
The group decided **Emeka would attend family gatherings once per quarter (four times a year), starting next year**. The revealing detail is in **Emeka’s own response**: after a terse "Fine… I can commit to that," he actually followed through by planning the Leeds gathering, offering to collect Mum from Reading, and blocking three weekends in late April—showing he was genuinely committed.

**A. Emeka**
